visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women, one wearing a black beanie and a varsity-style cardigan and another in a white textured sweater, stand at a white CHANEL cart featuring gold accents and a white canopy. The scene is set in a brightly lit, high-end luxury retail store with polished marble floors and gold-accented walls. (2) A series of close-up shots show the cart's contents, including small lollipops tied with black bows, glass bowls filled with white pearl decorations, and gold-sprayed wheat stalks. The lighting is warm and directional, accentuating the luxury branding and the intricate details of the small gift items. (3) The girl in the beanie holds a chocolate lollipop and smiles while the camera cuts to the woman in the white sweater sipping champagne from a long-stemmed glass. A male staff member in a black suit is partially visible assisting them in the background of the shop. (4) The focus shifts to hands assembling a golden wheat wreath. A man's hand in a suit jacket holds the wreath base while the two women use small tools to attach gold charms, including the number 5 and star shapes. The background shows jewelry display niches. (5) The two women sit at a table in a plush lounge area, meticulously crafting their wreaths with real wheat stalks. They are surrounded by Chanel-branded items and festive decor. The camera captures their concentration and the detailed textures of the crafting materials and the gold spray. (6) A final commemorative photo is staged in front of a large Chanel globe installation surrounded by white gift boxes. A polaroid photo of the two women is shown, and the video concludes with a selfie-style shot of them clinking champagne glasses and smiling warmly.
